'''JohnsonJedi The Deadly Death Star II''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JohnsonJedi]]
* '''Published:''' 11 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Deadly Death Star II
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 The Deadly Death Star II JohnsonJedi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck revolves around the Death Star II.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

There isn't much of one except I deploy a HUGE amout of star destroyers at the Death Star II and protect it.Most capital ships won't come near to help the starfighters destroy the Death Star II and Saber Squadron can handle the starfighters.
